images.fact: Businessman and former host of The Apprentice who won the US presidency in 2016 and again in 2024.
Became Vice President in 2025. He wrote the bestselling memoir Hillbilly Elegy.
US President from 2021 to 2025, and Barack Obama's Vice President before that.
The first Black US President, in office from 2009 to 2017.
The first female US Vice President (2021–2025). She ran for President in 2024.
First Lady, then Secretary of State. In 2016 she became the first woman nominated for President by a major US party.
Left-wing US senator who ran for President twice. Famous for his mittens meme in 2021.
Former KGB officer who has led Russia as President or Prime Minister since 1999.
Comedian and actor who became President of Ukraine in 2019 and led it through Russia's invasion.
Leader of China and the Chinese Communist Party since 2012.
Prime Minister of India since 2014, leading the world's most populous country.
Became France's youngest-ever president in 2017, aged 39.
Labour leader who won a landslide in 2024 and was UK Prime Minister until 2026.
Messy-haired Mayor of London, then UK Prime Minister from 2019 to 2022 during Brexit and COVID.
Prime Minister of Canada from 2015 to 2025. His father Pierre was also PM.
Labor leader who became Prime Minister of Australia in 2022. Nicknamed "Albo".

images.description: Former Prime Minister of New Zealand
images.fact: Became NZ Prime Minister at 37 in 2017. She led the country through the Christchurch attacks and COVID.
Has ruled North Korea since 2011, after his father and grandfather.
Israel's longest-serving Prime Minister, first elected in 1996.
Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince and Prime Minister, and the country's day-to-day ruler.
Germany's first female Chancellor, who led the country for 16 years (2005–2021).
Elected in 2025 as the first American pope, after Pope Francis.

images.description: King of the UK and Australia
images.fact: Became King in 2022 after his mother, Queen Elizabeth II, died.
The 14th Dalai Lama, who has lived in exile in India since 1959. Nobel Peace Prize winner.
Runs Tesla and SpaceX, owns X (Twitter), and is often the world's richest person.
Co-founded Microsoft in 1975. Now gives billions to charity through the Gates Foundation.
Started Amazon selling books from his garage in 1994. Also owns the rocket company Blue Origin.
Co-founded Nvidia, whose chips power AI. Famous for his black leather jacket.
Created Facebook in his Harvard dorm room in 2004. Now runs Meta (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp).
Runs OpenAI, the company that made ChatGPT.
Took over from Steve Jobs as Apple CEO in 2011 and ran the company for 15 years.
Co-founded Apple with Steve Jobs in 1976 and built the first Apple computers himself.
"The Oracle of Omaha", one of the most successful investors ever.
Former English teacher who founded Alibaba, China's biggest online shopping company.
Head of Hancock Prospecting and Australia's richest person.
Founded the Virgin Group (records, airlines, space flights) and is known for daring stunts.
Started skipping school to protest about climate change at age 15, sparking a worldwide movement.
Survived being shot for going to school, then became the youngest Nobel Prize winner at 17.
Hosted The Oprah Winfrey Show for 25 years: "You get a car! You get a car!"
Hosts The Joe Rogan Experience, one of the world's most popular podcasts.
The voice of nature documentaries like Planet Earth and Blue Planet for over 70 years.
Star of Keeping Up with the Kardashians and founder of the brand SKIMS.
Fiery chef from Hell's Kitchen and Kitchen Nightmares, with multiple Michelin stars.
Popular science communicator who hosted Cosmos and runs New York's Hayden Planetarium.
Captained Pakistan to win the 1992 Cricket World Cup, then became Prime Minister (2018–2022). Jailed since 2023.
Trained eye doctor who ruled Syria from 2000 until rebels overthrew him in 2024, after a long civil war.
Former bus driver who became Venezuela's president in 2013. He was captured and taken to the US in 2026.
Psychologist whose book 12 Rules for Life and his online lectures made him world famous.
Led the Liberal Party and the Opposition from 2022 until losing the 2025 election, where he also lost his own seat.
Prime Minister from 2018 to 2022, including COVID. Remembered for his Hawaii holiday during the 2019 bushfires.
Wealthy lawyer and businessman who was Prime Minister from 2015 to 2018, until his own party replaced him.
Prime Minister twice (2007–2010 and 2013). He made the National Apology to the Stolen Generations in 2008.
Australia's first female Prime Minister (2010–2013), famous for her 2012 "misogyny speech".
Prime Minister from 2013 to 2015. Famous for eating a raw onion and "stop the boats".
Former fish and chip shop owner who founded the One Nation party in 1997.
Became Australia's Foreign Minister in 2022. She was born in Malaysia and has been a senator since 2002.
Has been Australia's Treasurer, in charge of the federal budget, since 2022.
Became leader of the Liberal Party and Opposition Leader in 2026.
Labor leader who became Premier of NSW in 2023.

images.description: Former Premier of New South Wales
images.fact: NSW Premier from 2017 to 2021, who fronted daily COVID press conferences.
Victorian Premier from 2014 to 2023, who led Melbourne through the world's longest COVID lockdowns.
Former Deputy Prime Minister. He threatened to put down Johnny Depp's dogs in 2015, and later joined One Nation.
Mining magnate who founded his own political parties and is famous for huge election ad campaigns.
Iron ore billionaire who founded Fortescue, one of Australia's biggest mining companies.
Co-founded the Sydney software company Atlassian at uni, and became a billionaire.
Started Canva in Perth in her early 20s. It became one of the world's most valuable start-ups.
Adelaide-born media tycoon who built News Corp and Fox News.
Sydney "shock jock" who co-hosted The Kyle and Jackie O Show on breakfast radio from 2005 to 2026.
Has been Lord Mayor of Sydney since 2004, the longest in the city's history.
Founded the Dick Smith electronics stores and Australian-made food brand, and flew solo around the world.
